title: Metric k-median at factor one plus two over e
exact_target: For every fixed $\varepsilon >0$, is there a deterministic polynomial-bit-time algorithm for arbitrary finite rational metric k-median that opens at most k facilities and achieves approximation ratio $1+2/e+\varepsilon $?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
